name: The Hearthless
summary: A warmth-eating voidsent hollows out the Coerthan hamlet of Calderwick. Seal the Rift, kill the beast.
passive: Cold Light: at 0 HP a player is Hollowed (downed, not dead). An ally's action + a 4+ roll rekindles them at 5 HP.

statuses.name: Chill
statuses.clears: End of your next turn, or a warmth/fire heal

statuses.name: Frostbite
statuses.effect: 1 DMG at the start of your turn for 2 turns
statuses.clears: A potion or a healer action

statuses.name: Hollowed
statuses.clears: Ally action + roll 4+: back up at 5 HP

momentum_action.name: Whiteout
momentum_action.note: Fires when Enemy Momentum is full. Interception allowed.

enemies.name: Hearthless Wisps
enemies.abilities:
PHASE 1. Counts as one target; AOE hits it for full damage.
Flicker Bite: 3 random players, fail 1-3: 2 DMG + Chill.
Endless: while the Rift is open, regains 5 HP each enemy turn (GM adds it).

enemies.name: The Rift
enemies.abilities:
Damaged only by SEAL actions (aetherial, alchemical or engineering effort), using the normal DMG table.
Sealed: the Wisps stop regenerating.

enemies.name: The Hearthless
enemies.abilities:
PHASE 2: Ember Drain (1 chosen, fail 1-4: 4 DMG + Frostbite, heals 2). Rime Howl every other turn (all, fail 1-2: 2 DMG + Chill).
PHASE 3 at half HP: dodges on 1-3 (GM raises it). Hearth-Hunger hits the highest Momentum.
Weakness: fire/warmth-flavored attacks +1 DMG.

enemies.name: Rimebound Husks
enemies.abilities:
PHASE 2. Bodyguard: the first attack each round aimed at the Hearthless hits the Husks instead.
Trample: 2 chosen, fail 1-3: 3 DMG.
